text:
jordan: Hey — noticed a sudden bump in token consumption for SSE clients ~09:12 UTC. Looks like some clients are being billed twice for the same stream session.

lina: Ugh. Any obvious correlates in the console? route/model/region?

jordan: Mostly eu-west1, same model, spikes line up with proxy idle-pool rebinds. Console shows two active connections for the same resume_token for a brief ~1-2s window.

ben: Do you have an example trace id? can grep on resume_token.

jordan: trace: trace-2026-03-21-09:12 id=trc_9e3b
--- payload snippet ---
client_id=web-42 resume_token=rt_abc123 session_id=sess_77
event: resume
status: accepted
--- end ---

kavi: Hmm that looks like the proxy did a pooled-socket rebind while edge returned 204 -> client retried resume, upstream accepted both. We had a guard but maybe it races with the resume dedupe window.

mira: From UX: the console is showing quota usage doubling for that session. Ops wants a way to visualize dedupe hits vs true consumption. Right now it just attributes tokens to route.

lina: Can you reproduce locally? maybe a small script that simulates a midstream 204 from proxy + immediate client reconnect.

jordan: Repro script (very minimal):
```bash
# open SSE, then stderr simulate proxy rebind 204, then client re-resume
curl -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-lite' &
# wait 1s then kill connection and reopen with same resume_token
```
Not exact but gives the timing.

ben: Telemetry shows resume_accept_count jumped by 2 within 50ms for same resume_token in a few thousand requests during the incident window.

kavi: Our dedupe is server-side using a short-lived resume_claim table keyed by resume_token with ttl 100ms. If proxy rebind causes a second accept after the ttl but before client sees terminal, billing counts twice. We can either extend ttl or make resume_idempotency txn stronger.

lina: Extending ttl might hide real replays but reduce duplicates. What's the perf cost?

kavi: TTL -> 500ms cuts duplicates in sim but increases memory for claims during high fanout. But claims are tiny. Tradeoff probably acceptable for now.

mira: Product perspective — prefer conservative change that reduces duplicate charges without impacting normal reconnect UX. Also want console telemetry to show when resume_ttl prevented dedupe vs when duplicates actually billed.

jordan: Quick mitigation: roll proxy change to avoid returning 204 on rebind for resume-able sessions (return a short-lived sticky 302 to same edge) — that would reduce the race. Ops thoughts?

ops-bot: @deploy-bot canary started: rollout/proxy-sticky-302 v2 -> 2/10 hosts

ben: I'm not thrilled about sticky 302 as permanent fix; it's a workaround. Longer-term we should make resume_accept atomic on write side and ensure billing dedupe happens at payment aggregation layer too.

kavi: Agreed — i'll open a tiny RFC for an atomic resume_claim txn + idempotent billing pass. For now i'll push resume_ttl bump to 500ms in staging and monitor.

lina: Also can we add a console flag that shows "dedupe prevented" events as a line in the per-route chart? Mira can you mock a UX?

mira: Yup — mock incoming: a small badge in the token breakdown: "dedupe_prevents: 24 (last 1h)" and a link to sample traces. Works for sales/ops.

jordan: After TTL bump in staging, duplicate counts dropped ~92% in replay test. Pushed to canary.

ops-bot: @deploy-bot canary completed: rollout/proxy-sticky-302 v2 -> 10/10 hosts

ben: Please add an alert that fires when resume_accept_count / resume_claims > 1.1 over 5m — that'll catch regressions.

kavi: Added alert in staging, will promote to prod once RFC merged.

lina: Thanks. We should also add a lightweight telemetry metric for "resume_replay_window_ms" so console can chart TTL tuning over time.

mira: I'll add UX mock and put in next sprint for Console team.

jordan: TL;DR: root cause = proxy idle-pool rebind -> duplicate resume accept within small window -> billing double-count. Short-term: increase resume_claim ttl and proxy sticky behavior. Medium-term: atomic resume_claim + billing dedupe + console visibility. :white_check_mark:

ben: Add postmortem? low-sev but customer visible.

lina: I'll start a short postmortem thread and attach the traces.

mira: Great, tag me for console telemetry work.

ops-bot: Incident note: mitigation deployed, monitoring in place.
